name: Pidgin camerounais (Kamtok)
region: Nord-Ouest, Sud-Ouest, Littoral et grandes villes (≈ 50 % de la population le parle sous une forme)
status_note: Langue véhiculaire nationale très répandue, mais pas 'langue nationale' au sens identitaire : à présenter en complément d'une langue nationale (ex. Fulfulde).
sources: Kouega, J.-P. (2008). A Dictionary of Cameroon Pidgin English Usage. Lincom Europa.
Ayafor, M. & Green, M. (2017). Cameroon Pidgin English: a comprehensive grammar. John Benjamins.
Usage courant (feyman, wahala, chop, tok) — à valider par locuteurs

entries.term.balance: Balans (moni wey e remain for ya akaunt)
entries.term.fees: Charges (moni wey dem go chop for di sevis)
entries.term.beneficiary: Pesin wey go receive di moni
entries.term.loan: Loan (moni wey you go pay back)
entries.term.interest: Interest (moni wey you go add when you pay back)
entries.term.history: Ol di tins wey you don do
entries.term.pin: Ya secret code (PIN) — no show am to anybody
entries.term.otp: Code wey dem sen for SMS — na secret
entries.term.irreversible: You no fit change am again
entries.term.name: Nem
entries.ph.fee_percent: Di charges na {PERCENT} for di moni wey you sen.
entries.ph.fee_range: If you sen from {AMOUNT} reach {AMOUNT2}, di charges na {AMOUNT3}.
entries.ph.total_is: Ol togeda wey go komot for ya akaunt: {AMOUNT}.
entries.ph.total_debit: Ol togeda, {AMOUNT} go komot for ya akaunt.
entries.ph.send_to_phone: You dey sen {AMOUNT} give {NAME}, fon nomba {PHONE}.
entries.ph.send_to_number: You dey sen {AMOUNT} for dis nomba: {PHONE}.
entries.ph.never_share_pin: Neva give ya secret code (PIN) to anybody. At all at all!
entries.ph.never_share_otp: Di code wey dem sen for SMS na secret. Neva give am to anybody!
entries.ph.staff_never_ask: Di sevis people dem neva go ask ya secret code. Any pesin wey ask am na feyman!
entries.ph.insufficient: Ya moni no rich for dis transaction.
entries.ph.wrong_pin_attempts: Di secret code no correct. You fit try only {NUM} taim again, after dat dem go block ya akaunt.
entries.ph.attempts_left: You fit try only {NUM} taim again. After dat, dem go block ya akaunt.
entries.ph.success: E don waka fine! Di transaction don pass.
entries.ph.failed: Di transaction no waka. Ya moni no komot.
entries.ph.check_before_confirm: Check di nem, di nomba an di moni fine fine before you confam.
entries.ph.irreversible: When you confam, you no fit cancel am again. Di moni don go for good.
entries.ph.enter_pin: Put ya secret code for confam. Hide di screen.
entries.ph.enter_amount: Write haw moch moni you wan sen.
entries.ph.enter_number: Write di fon nomba for di pesin wey go receive.
entries.ph.network_error: Network wahala. Try am again later. Ya moni no komot.
entries.ph.limit_exceeded: Di moni too plenty: e pass di limit.
entries.ph.fraud_warning: Tek kia for feyman dem wey wan chop ya moni or ya code!
entries.ph.account_blocked: Dem don block ya akaunt. Go for official agency.
entries.ph.pending: Di transaction still dey go. Wait, no start am again.
entries.cat.balance: Dis message dey tok about ya balans (moni wey remain).
entries.cat.fees: Dis message dey tok about charges.
entries.cat.transfer: Dis message dey tok about sen moni.
entries.cat.confirm: Summary: check everytin before you confam.
entries.cat.warning: Tek kia: important message for ya protection.
entries.cat.pin: Dis message dey tok about ya secret code: no give am to anybody.
entries.cat.fraud: DANGER: dis one fit be feyman bizness!
entries.cat.condition: Dis message get condition or limit. Read am fine.
entries.flag.negation: Dis message dey forbid sometin (no… / neva).
entries.flag.condition: Dis message get condition (if, only, before, maximum…).
entries.guide.balance: Here you go see di moni wey remain for ya akaunt.
entries.guide.fees: Here you go see haw moch di sevis go chop for each transfer.
entries.guide.transfer_number: Step 1: write di fon nomba for di pesin wey go receive.
entries.guide.transfer_amount: Step 2: write haw moch moni you wan sen.
entries.guide.transfer_check: Step 3: look di charges an di total.
entries.guide.transfer_confirm: Step 4: confam. Put ya secret code an hide di screen.
entries.guide.summary: Check di nem, di nomba, di moni, di charges an di total. If one tin no correct, press Cancel.
entries.guide.error: E no waka. Ya moni no komot. Read wetin cause am.
entries.guide.success: E don waka. Keep di reference nomba as proof.
entries.guide.security: Advice for protect ya moni. Read am fine.
entries.ui.unvalidated: native speaker never check am yet
entries.ui.total_ok: Di count correct: moni + charges = total.
entries.ui.total_mismatch: TEK KIA: moni + charges no reach di total wey dem show. No confam!
entries.ui.scam_alert: Real sevis neva ask ya secret code, an neva ask you pay before you receive prize. Na feyman!
